sources.title: Government of The Gambia: Immigration and Visas
sources.officialityEvidence: The live gambia.gov.gm page is the central Government's visitor-entry guidance and directly links the Gambia Immigration Department's entry-requirements page.
sources.supportingExcerpt: Citizens of the United Kingdom, full members of the European Union, the Commonwealth, [and] ECOWAS ... do not require a visa.

sources.title: Gambia Immigration Department: Visa
sources.officialityEvidence: The central Government's Immigration and Visas page links GID as its further visa-information authority. GID's live Visa page is its named country schedule and WordPress API reports it modified 2025-10-31.
sources.supportingExcerpt: Countries That Need Both Visa And Clearance For African Countries

sources.title: Gambia Immigration Department: Entry Requirements
sources.officialityEvidence: The central Government's Immigration and Visas page directly links this live GID entry-requirements service; GID's WordPress API reports it modified 2025-10-31.
sources.supportingExcerpt: Visa can be acquired from all Gambian Embassies and some Consulates abroad as well as Visa upon arrival at the border.

policies.title: Named visa-and-clearance ordinary passports: advance visitor entry permission
policies.summary: GID's country schedule expressly places these passports in a category requiring both a visa and entry clearance; its entry rules require clearance approval before travel.
conditions: The Visa page expressly lists these countries as needing both visa and clearance.
GID requires approved entry clearance before arrival.
A border-issued visa cannot replace the named prior clearance.
GID describes sticker or endorsement issuance; no eVisa is established.
Work, residence, transit, health, security and special-document rules remain outside the visitor baseline.

policies.title: Named clearance-only ordinary passports: advance visitor entry permission
policies.summary: GID's country schedule expressly places these passports in its clearance-only category, and the entry page makes approved clearance a pre-arrival condition.
conditions: The Visa page expressly puts these countries in a clearance-only category.
GID requires approved entry clearance before arrival; this is advance permission, not visa-free access, ETA or eVisa.
A general border-visa statement does not remove an expressly required clearance.
Admission and special-document, residence, work and transit conditions are outside the baseline.

policies.title: Named visa-only ordinary passports: visa on arrival
policies.summary: GID's country schedule expressly labels these passports visa-only, and its entry requirements expressly permit visa acquisition at a gazetted border.
conditions: The Visa page expressly puts these countries in a visa-only category, without entry-clearance language.
GID says a visa can be acquired at gazetted ports of entry; that route is normalized as visa on arrival.
GID describes sticker or endorsement issuance, not eVisa.
Admission, stay, work, residence, transit, health and security conditions remain separate.
